How it works

Four steps from idea to live site.

01
Discovery
A short call to understand your business and what the site needs to do for you.
02
Design
A free working demo built around your brand — real layout, real colours.
03
Build
The full site — responsive, fast, wired to WhatsApp or a form so leads reach you.
04
Launch
Domain, hosting and deployment handled, plus a quick handover.
FAQ

Questions people usually ask before saying yes.

Yes — once the project is paid for, all files are handed over to you. If hosting, domain and analytics are set up under your own email/account, you have full ownership and control from day one. If they're set up under our account for convenience, we hand over the files, but ongoing monitoring and maintenance on our end would be a separate charge.
A free working demo usually comes together in 2-3 days. Once you approve the direction, the full build — responsive, tested, connected to WhatsApp or a form — typically takes about a week, depending on how much content and revisions are involved.
Hosting is included as part of your final package — it's factored into the quote up front, not billed separately after the fact. I'll walk you through exactly what's covered before you commit to anything.
Revisions during the demo stage are free, same as the demo itself — we go back and forth until you're happy with the direction. Once the site is built and launched, further changes are handled as paid work.
No cost, no obligation. The demo is there so you can see exactly what you'd be getting before spending anything — if it's not the right fit, that's completely fine.
